verses.text: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!

xrefs.text: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
Those who were musicians, the heads of Levite families, stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night.
Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!
Now, my sons, do not be negligent, for the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, to minister before Him, and to burn incense.”

verses.text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!

xrefs.text: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.
Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:

verses.text: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

xrefs.text: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
